title: Day 84: Chilean Prosecutors Seek 35-Year Sentences for CJNG Meth Operation — Cartel's Transnational Manufacturing Reach Documented; El Sapo Hunt Day 84; 25 Days to FIFA World Cup
detail: Day 84 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CJNG CHILE TRIAL — 35-YEAR SENTENCES SOUGHT (El Mostrador, May 17, 2026): Chilean prosecutors from the Regional Prosecutor's Office of Antofagasta requested 35-year prison sentences for two Mexican nationals convicted as members of a CJNG advance team that established a clandestine methamphetamine production hub in Chile. The operation produced 844 kilograms of methamphetamine intended for distribution to Australia — illustrating CJNG's transnational manufacturing ambitions, moving production facilities to third-country jurisdictions with lower law enforcement capacity and establishing direct-to-market Australia distribution chains outside the traditional U.S.-focused model. The two suspects were detained in Chile after a joint investigation by Chilean and international authorities. The case highlights CJNG's transnational expansion strategy under the succession crisis: by pre-positioning manufacturing operations in South America and Australasian distribution networks before El Mencho's death, the cartel has demonstrated organizational resilience that transcends any single leadership takedown. SUCCESSION BINARY — DAY 84: El 03 (Juan Carlos Valencia González, confirmed leader — El País, April 6) vs. El Sapo (Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán, military wing, at large). The El 03/Los Cuinis financial consolidation continues. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 84: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target (named May 3, 2026). Day 84 with no confirmed capture or elimination — CJNG's military chief maintaining sicario recruitment networks in Jalisco, Michoacán, and Puebla. His personal security detail includes former Mexican Army, Marines, and Colombian and Guatemalan former combatants. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 84: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspension ratified May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized. POST-EL CHUCKY MANZANILLO VOID (Day 8): Port of Manzanillo CJNG plaza command transition continues — no publicly identified successor to El Chucky. Embedded port relationships intact. PLAN KUKULKAN — 25 DAYS: 25 days to FIFA World Cup 2026 June 11 opening match. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium) hosts 4 group-stage matches; nationwide 130,000-person security deployment continues with heightened CJNG-specific interdiction framework. GUERRERO DISPLACEMENT CONTEXT (Day 83, ongoing): The Washington Post May 16 investigation on Los Ardillos drone-bomb attacks on indigenous Guerrero communities — 800+ displaced, 3 community police killed — continues to document the broader cartel fragmentation dynamics following El Mencho's death.

media.caption: Chilean prosecutors seek 35-year sentences for two CJNG Mexican nationals who produced 844kg of methamphetamine in Chile for Australian distribution — revealing cartel's transnational manufacturing strategy
